standardization: Within season and candidate pool, population standard deviation; season-pool median imputation
standings: Conference and league rank by final regular-season win percentage; normalized to 0-1; ties averaged; playoff seed and play-in results excluded
validation_warning: 2016-2026 results previously inspected; retrospective comparison, not a fresh untouched test.
availability: Penalty coefficient times max(0, ceil(0.85 * actual team games) - player games). Deficit is not standardized or centered. Coefficient constrained strictly negative (upper numerical bound -1e-8). Multi-team rows use season-max team schedule as marked fallback.
